frames: t = 0..100 (101 service records per episode, M protocol)
gt_points: face-referenced matterport_mesh vertices inside card box_m (z-up metres)
observed_cloud_primary: all pixels with mask & z-depth < 70 runtime units (10 m), frozen sensor back-projection
comp_distance: mean (and median) NN distance over all GT vertices, unclipped, cm
visible_vertices: within 0.05 m of the full-depth back-projection of any legal pose (all panoramas x 3 elev x 8 azim), whole-house mesh
